BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Triceps
SECONDARY
Front Delts

Instructions

Preparation: Stand or sit, hold one dumbbell with both hands straight overhead. Keep elbows close to your ears and pointed at the ceiling.

1

Hold the dumbbell overhead with both hands.

2

Keep your core braced and elbows up.

3

Bend elbows; lower the dumbbell behind head.

4

Keep your upper arms beside your head.

5

Straighten your elbows and squeeze your triceps.

6

Keep the dumbbell steady at full extension.

Watch out

Elbows flaring wide takes the triceps out of it. Keep them tucked by your ears, pointing up, and move only from the elbow.
